comparisonRule: Run both instructions in fresh external-Agent sessions with identical input.json and the same search capability/time budget. Score observed outputs only.

metricDefinitions.research_dimension_coverage: Count distinct required dimensions with evidence or an explicit Unknown (0-10).
metricDefinitions.first_party_sources: Count valid Grade A direct first-party sources supporting a relevant claim.
metricDefinitions.alternatives_considered: Count materially different approaches, not same-class vendor variants.
metricDefinitions.contradiction_searches: Count documented counter-searches tied to a core option.
metricDefinitions.blockers_unknowns_identified: Count decision-changing unknowns with a named resolution path.
metricDefinitions.conclusion_change: Record whether contradiction/alternative evidence changed verdict or recommendation; do not assume that change is always better.

passPolicy: No automatic winner. Human reviewer records both observations; any superiority claim requires observed evidence across the listed metrics.
